lines: I remember the page turning back from a <shake>very bad ending</shake>.
Your face is one of the first words I could <pulse>read again</pulse>.
You helped pull me back when even my name felt far away.
The chapter is damaged, but your name survived in the <italic>margin</italic>.
I remember fragments: weakness, gold, a bitter draught, and you waiting.
The memory is rough around the edges, but your face stayed in it.
I remember you. Some books should be opened <pulse>slowly</pulse> after a curse.
I know you helped. I also remember why my hands still shake.
The cure left echoes behind. Stand where I can breathe around them.
I have seen broken record-keeping with better instincts than you.
